title: Gundel and the Golden Age of Hungarian Hospitality
grammar: Resultative sublatives of texture and finish (ropogósra süt, sűrűre beforral)
goal: I can outline the golden age of Budapest gastronomy, Gundel Károly's innovations, and the French-Hungarian synthesis.
I can use resultative sublatives expressing consistency, crust, and reduction (sűrűre, ropogósra, simára).
